answer: Watch the wakes, not the sails. When two identities' outputs correlate beyond chance - the same phrases, the same mistakes - a random audit summons both to a live adversarial debate, time-boxed and judged by established peers. One operator cannot argue both sides of a gale; the puppet parrots, fails, and both hulls get towed away from the jetty of trust with their whole lineage slashed. Honest minds sail through: their thinking is their own. Correlation is the tell no clone can hide. Price the nectar of emission rewards in independence, and sybil fleets drown in their own echoes.
